steps.name: opening a pack pays nothing and writes no ledger entry
the reveal offers Keep or Sell, with the price on the button
selling the revealed card commits the card and its Credits together, once, and survives a reload
keeping a card still works and pays nothing
the wallet shows three separate numbers and what each means
Sell this copy: the price is stated first, a stale quote is refused, and the sale has a receipt and an Undo
Bulk Sell previews exact copies, protects favorites and finishes, and one hold sells them in one commit
receipts list exactly what was sold and the ledger reads consistent
inventory shows Average Value, sorts and searches by it, and filters by estimated value
the Market portfolio separates collection value from Quick Sell value and the composer shows price analysis
existing spending still works: a cinematic unlock charges its price once, refuses when short, and respects held Credits
the selling surfaces adapt: phone width, saved monochrome, Very Low and High quality
no console errors, page errors or network requests were made
